title: RSA-PSS C_Sign/C_Verify missing WP11_FITS_U32 guards
description: The RSA-PSS bypass path in C_Sign (direct call to wp11_soft_key_rsa_pss_sign) and C_Verify casts CK_ULONG ulDataLen and ulSignatureLen to word32 without WP11_FITS_U32 guards. The AES-GCM path has an explicit UINT32_MAX guard. On 64-bit hosts a caller can pass >4GB buffers; silent truncation corrupts the hash computation.
